# License texts

Unmodified SPDX texts from https://github.com/spdx/license-list-data/tree/main/text
are provided for reference and redistribution alongside third-party components.
These texts do not assert that all components use all of these licenses.

The build helper copies additional installed upstream notices into `installed/`
and records exact versions / upstream source references. Before releasing a
binary, audit the **actual** bundled Qt/Python components and retain their
component-specific license notices. See THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md in the project root.
